{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values in key columns
print("Missing values in key columns:")
print(sales_df[['channel', 'customer_segment', 'converted']].isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicates
print("\nNumber of duplicate rows:")
duplicates = sales_df.duplicated().sum()
print(duplicates)

# Check if any duplicate rows are in the filtered group
filtered_df = sales_df[(sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]
dup_in_filtered = filtered_df.duplicated().sum()
print(f"Number of duplicate rows in filtered group: {dup_in_filtered}")"}
